result.reason: The redline appropriately reduces the non-renewal notice period to 30 days, retains 12-month automatic renewals, and adds the required 60-day Vendor reminder. However, it does not include any cap on renewal price increases. The preferred position requires the lesser of CPI and 3%, and even the fallback requires a cap of no more than 5%. The operative language therefore does not fully reach either playbook position, notwithstanding the accurate margin comment regarding the notice window.
